- Initialize a product accumulator to 1 and a flag found_odd to False. Iterate through each digit of n (convert to string or use modulo/division).  
- For each digit, if it is odd (digit % 2 == 1), multiply it into the accumulator and set found_odd to True.  
- After processing all digits, return the accumulator if found_odd is True; otherwise return 0.
